title: Make the semantic vocabulary RDF-interoperable (microdata x OTel)
notes:
Commissioned in session opencode://ses_ea512e94affeKEPqju0qHMPIrE after the independent design review: design/tabula-rasa/design0.gpt6a.md section 5 hand-rolls vocabulary naming, typing, identity, and provenance with no RDF backbone.

Full write-up: design/tabula-rasa/rdf-gap0.glm53m.md (mismatches, prior art, acceptance sketch).

Recommendation: O1 single vocabulary source plus generators (microdata profile with dot-free names, JSON-LD context, semconv-to-IRI mapping, TS types/validators) now; O2 application/ld+json representation with round-trip conformance next; O3 RDF-native internals deferred behind explicit triggers. Key fact: dots are legal in IRI path segments, so predicate IRIs can preserve OTel semconv names verbatim; microdata stays the constrained dot-free HTML projection.

Reconcile first: sibling commits 3dfd9c38..60cd66e0 already exercise 170-quad TriG/N-Quads round trips (oxigraph 0.5.12) and own design/ontology, design/observation-queries, and design/script-runtime; align vocabulary decisions with those modules before minting IRIs or generator sources.

Acceptance: lossless semconv name round-trip over a pinned registry snapshot; stable item/JSON-LD/triple-set digest across re-encoding; OTel bool/int/double/array types preserved as XSD typed literals; evidence rendered as triple terms without changing the base-graph digest; CI fails on generated-artifact drift.

title: Host a queryable microdata-ified view of captured pages
notes:
Fun/exploratory ask from the operator (session opencode://ses_ea512e94affeKEPqju0qHMPIrE): a hosted "virtual DOM" that is the microdata-ified tree of everything captured, so other people, tools, and agents can query the captured page via standard microdata. Priority deliberately low.

Shape: (1) renderer from retained semantic items (design/tabula-rasa/design0.gpt6a.md sections 4-5) to HTML or an in-process virtual DOM, marked up with the pageread vocabulary (itemscope/itemtype/itemprop/itemid), pinned to exact content revisions. (2) Host surface options: served static HTML per conversation/resource (browser-findable, view-source-able, scraper-friendly); in-process virtual DOM queryable without a browser (linkedom-style); a microdata-to-JSON endpoint following the HTML spec conversion; later an RDF endpoint via the W3C Microdata-to-RDF mapping. (3) Untrusted-content rule: captured conversation text must not execute on render; sanitize per the owned-reader rendering policy flagged in design0 sections 4/11. (4) Query results carry revision and coverage, pinned to a publication boundary.

Acceptance sketch: for a captured conversation the host serves a document where any conforming microdata extractor (HTML spec JSON conversion) recovers exactly the pinned semantic items; itemid/itemtype round-trips hold; hostile message text cannot inject markup or script; stable digest per revision; native browser find works on the served page.

Reconcile before building: pageread-semantics-rdf (blocked-by it: consume the generated microdata profile instead of hand-rolling names), and sibling modules design/ontology, design/observation-queries, design/script-runtime (those sessions already round-trip reader publication through a mock PDS with ATProto discovery).
